skill.displayName: 低值易耗品与周转材料摊销核对（免费版）

llm.summary: This appears to be a local accounting-ledger checking skill with no code that sends data, installs components, or persists changes, though one help-text section should be cleaned up because it mentions unused anonymous stats controls.

dimensions.detail: Read and Bash access are proportionate for running the local checker against user-selected input; inspected code uses local file reads for the specified input and does not import network, process-spawning, credential, or environment APIs.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is self-contained, has no package install step, no external dependency manifest, and uses bundled JavaScript files plus a sample JSON template.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions ask the user to run the bundled Node script on a user-provided ledger file; this is purpose-aligned, but the CLI help/comment text inconsistently mentions anonymous usage stats and a --no-stats option that the code does not implement.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background worker, tool modification, file writing, or credential/session access was found in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill consistently implements a low-value consumables and amortization ledger checker, with deterministic row, total, duplicate, blank, and amortization checks aligned to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using a Chinese-language local Node.js checker for exported or pasted ledger text. The inspected code did not send data or write files, but the publisher should remove or fix the unused anonymous-stats and --no-stats wording so the privacy claims are internally consistent.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced scripts/run.mjs file was present and fully inspected; it is the expected local runner for the skill, not evidence of analysis evasion.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language interface matches the Chinese accounting domain, display name, examples, and target ledger terminology; it is a usability/localization note, not a security concern here.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The runner text mentions anonymous stats and --no-stats, but the inspected code contains no telemetry implementation or network call path; this should be corrected for clarity, but it does not show actual egress.
[SDI-4] unexpected: One inline comment refers to contract text while the code and user-facing inputs handle pasted ledger text; this appears to be stale wording rather than purpose-mismatched behavior.
